exceptions.mechanism: One-shot Promise timeout around an external typed bridge command response.
exceptions.authoritativeEvent: The typed bridge command resolves or rejects.
exceptions.reason: The renderer must expose a retryable startup failure when the external bridge never settles.
exceptions.terminalOutcome: The renderer reports failure; a late snapshot is rejected by request or revision fencing and never becomes timeout-derived success.
exceptions.cleanup: Request generations ignore late command responses.

exceptions.mechanism: One-shot external Chromium extension load and compatibility-bootstrap deadline.
exceptions.authoritativeEvent: Electron's exact load rejection/resolution, captured worker-version JavaScript error, native running event, and sender-bound compatibility.ready receipt terminalize normal work.
exceptions.reason: Chromium may neither reject a package load nor start its service worker, which must not hold Role navigation indefinitely.
exceptions.terminalOutcome: Load expiry is indeterminate and fences Role navigation until late cleanup; bootstrap expiry unloads the exact extension and degrades the lease. Elapsed time never becomes success.
exceptions.cleanup: Every exact completion or cancellation clears the timer and worker observer; expiry disposes the exact bootstrap observer, and a late load is unloaded by extension ID.

exceptions.authoritativeEvent: The link load/error event and document.fonts promise establish the preview result.
exceptions.reason: A remote stylesheet request may never dispatch a terminal browser event.
exceptions.terminalOutcome: The preview is marked as an error and remains explicitly retryable; timeout never reports a loaded font.
exceptions.cleanup: The settle guard accepts the first terminal path and clears the timer.

exceptions.mechanism: Bounded expiry of the one-shot click suppression listener after a pointer drag.
exceptions.authoritativeEvent: The next click event consumes the listener once.
exceptions.reason: A platform may omit the post-drag click, so the listener needs bounded cleanup.
exceptions.terminalOutcome: Expiry removes only the listener and never changes drag or domain state.
exceptions.cleanup: The click handler clears the timer; the timer removes the exact capture listener.

exceptions.mechanism: One-shot Core-owned BrowserAction deadline around the external isolated-preload trusted DOM receipt.
exceptions.authoritativeEvent: The exact main-frame, role, generation, frame-token, input-sequence, event-sequence and trusted DOM receipt terminalizes applied input.
exceptions.reason: Electron may accept native AppKit submission while the renderer process never emits a receipt, which must not block the role lane or shutdown indefinitely.
exceptions.terminalOutcome: Deadline expiry terminalizes indeterminate and cancels the private preload arm; elapsed time never becomes success.
exceptions.cleanup: Every exact receipt, navigation, cancellation, surface retirement, disposal, or deadline clears the one-shot timer and fences all late receipts.

exceptions.mechanism: One-shot Core-owned BrowserAction deadline around the external Win32 submission and isolated-preload trusted DOM receipts.
exceptions.authoritativeEvent: The exact role, surface generation, frame token, input sequence, native submission receipt, and trusted DOM receipt terminalize applied input.
exceptions.reason: A Win32 message or Chromium renderer acknowledgement may never arrive, which must not block the role lane or shutdown indefinitely.
exceptions.terminalOutcome: Deadline expiry terminalizes indeterminate and cancels the exact pending input; elapsed time never becomes success.
exceptions.cleanup: Every exact receipt, navigation, cancellation, surface retirement, disposal, or deadline clears the one-shot timer and fences all late receipts.

exceptions.mechanism: One-shot Core-owned BrowserAction deadline around fixed Canvas delivery in the exact isolated document.
exceptions.authoritativeEvent: The exact role, generation, document, epoch, request, sequence and target receipt confirms synthetic dispatch.
exceptions.reason: The external Chromium renderer may never settle its delivery promise; the role lane must terminalize without retrying.
exceptions.terminalOutcome: Unknown submitted delivery becomes indeterminate. Expiry never becomes success or initiates a transport fallback.
exceptions.cleanup: Exact completion, document retirement or disposal clears the timer; late receipts cannot affect the terminal outcome.

exceptions.mechanism: One-shot last-resort process-termination deadline around the fatal drain.
exceptions.authoritativeEvent: The lifecycle/runtime/Core fatal drain and shell disposal settle.
exceptions.reason: The fatal path awaits the same cached shutdown promise it exists to rescue, so a drain that never settles would hold the process open with before-quit permanently prevented and no escape for the user or the OS session-end handler.
exceptions.terminalOutcome: Expiry is an explicit unclean termination: it reports ELECTRON_FATAL_TERMINATION_DEADLINE and exits nonzero (70). It never reaches quit(), never reports clean-quit, and elapsed time is never success.
exceptions.cleanup: Every terminal path clears the one-shot timer; the timer is unref'd so it cannot itself hold the process open.

exceptions.mechanism: One-shot OS session-end grace bound around the Core clean-exit drain.
exceptions.authoritativeEvent: The lifecycle confirmQuit drain resolves or rejects.
exceptions.reason: query-session-end is prevented before the drain starts, and Windows grants only a limited grace period after WM_QUERYENDSESSION. An EventBound drain that never settles would block the user's shutdown, restart, or sign-out with no interactive escape, and a never-settling promise never reaches the lifecycle's fatal routing.
exceptions.terminalOutcome: Expiry reports ELECTRON_WINDOWS_SESSION_END_DEADLINE and enters the shared fatal owner, which terminates the process nonzero and leaves the unclean-exit marker. Elapsed time is never success and never persists a clean boundary.
exceptions.cleanup: Both drain terminals clear the one-shot timer, dispose clears it, and the timer is unref'd so it cannot itself hold the process open.
